properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: JWT 签名密钥，生产环境必须替换为随机长字符串

properties.name: jwt.lock-minutes
properties.description: 登录失败锁定时长（分钟）

properties.name: jwt.max-fail-count
properties.description: 连续登录失败次数阈值，超过后锁定账号

properties.name: jwt.header
properties.description: 携带 Token 的 HTTP 请求头名称

properties.name: audit.enabled
properties.description: 是否启用操作审计日志

properties.name: password.require-letter
properties.description: 密码是否必须包含字母

properties.name: password.require-digit
properties.description: 密码是否必须包含数字

properties.name: password.history-keep
properties.description: 密码历史检查条数，0 表示不检查历史密码

properties.name: password.initial
properties.description: 新建账号默认初始密码

properties.name: password.force-reset-on-startup
properties.description: 启动时是否强制将种子账号（admin/hr01/emp01）密码重置为默认值。dev=true, prod=false
